description: 小说创作助手，维护小说连贯性和一致性。核心功能：(1) 创建/续写小说章节 (2) 管理人物设定和世界观 (3) 追踪伏笔和时间线 (4) 压缩记忆文件控制上下文 (5) 本地章节备份 (6) 多作品并行管理 (7) 人物对话风格样本库。触发词：小说、章节、续写、人物设定、创建小说、世界观、伏笔、时间线、剧情概要、记忆文件压缩、备份章节。适用场景：连载小说创作、长篇小说管理、多人物复杂剧情维护、多人协作写作。

name: novel-atlas
description: 把一本男频小说（EPUB/TXT/PDF）变成单文件离线「互动看板」——阅读器、世界地图、人物关系网络、成长曲线、感情线、器物图谱，一条命令跑完。用户提出「给小说做个看板 / 小说可视化 / 看书工作台 / 整理人物关系和地图 / 生成小说设定图 / 男频网文世界观整理」时使用。也适用于在 10MB+ 巨型生成式 HTML 上做安全增量增强。
allowed_tools: Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep

name: novel-audit
description: 주기 광역 감사 실행 — K4 리듬·프라미스 방치·원장 정합(결정론) + 샘플 EP 원장↔본문 표류 대조(LLM). 감사 주기 도래 시 write가 차단되므로 이 명령으로 해소한다. "/novel-audit"에 사용.

name: novel-audit
description: 自进化小说审核工具。审核节奏/爽点/逻辑/发布水平/AI味检测，提供打分+逐章批注。 核心特性：每拆解一本书自动学习新知识点，遗忘低价值知识，整合重复知识。 知识库随使用次数增长，审核能力持续提升。平台适配：番茄小说、起点小说。 触发词：审核小说、拆解样板书、查节奏、查爽点、小说打分、学习这本书、查AI味、去AI化。
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Exec

name: novel-audit-repair
description: 小说审稿、诊断与修复。用于检查章节风格偏移、剧情 bug、角色 OOC、节奏拖沓、伏笔断裂、设定矛盾、AI 痕迹，并给出修复方案或重写，适合 chapter-audit、chapter-analysis、chapter-repair、story-deep-audit 任务。

name: novel-auto-writer
description: 小说自动化写作技能 v5.0，支持20维度质量评估（增强梗含量/潮流热度/新鲜感）、Meme数据库、月度更新。当用户要求写小说、生成章节、网文写作或需要小说创作支持时调用。

name: novel-backup
description: 自动版本备份 — 每章定稿归档、设定文档快照、增量+全量双轨策略、智能版本号与清理规则

name: novel-bible
description: Whitepaper structure, premise/theme guardrails, and approval gates for the novel studio

name: novel-body
description: 小说分章正文：2000–3000 字、情节点控长、主视角推进、章末读者预知钩子；覆盖短篇/男频/女频长篇

name: novel-bookplan
description: 全书架构、分卷节奏、长期主线规划。母型诊断 → beats 蓝图 → 分卷节奏卡。触发词："全书大纲""卷结构""bookplan""故事母型""分卷规划""重排卷结构"。

name: novel-brainhole-mine
description: 从多部作品挖掘脑洞模式。 触发条件: "挖掘脑洞"、"提取反转模式"、"brainhole mine"

name: novel-brainstorm
description: **版本**: 2.0 **功能**: Step 1 & 3 - 需求澄清与头脑风暴（交互式）

name: novel-brainstorm
description: 把模糊想法收敛成能开工的 project.md。 一次只问一个问题，每个问题附带 2-4 个选项。 只产出 project.md + 人物/ 文件夹，不造其他文件。

name: novel-brainstorm
description: 引导用户填充 story.md 的核心创意要素（一句话简介、核心矛盾、30 章承诺、市场定位、文风方向）。当用户说"讨论世界观"、"开始 brainstorm"、"想剧情"、"聊一下这个故事"、"我想写小说但还没想清楚怎么写"、"continue brainstorming the story" 时触发。此 skill 不创建世界观/角色/章节，仅在概念层做收敛。

name: novel-brainstorm
description: 头脑风暴引擎——创意候选生成、反套路推演、假设性推演、题材融合。在任意创作阶段按需调用。
allowed_tools: Read Grep Bash Agent AskUserQuestion WebSearch

name: novel-brainstorm
description: 小说创意头脑风暴与内核提炼。在缺乏灵感、想拓展方向或需要提炼一句话故事 (Logline) 时使用。

name: novel-brainstorming
description: Use before designing outlines or drafting prose — conducts a disciplined Socratic interview to explore core thematic intent, tone, emotional resonance, comparable titles (comps), target audience, and high-concept story seeds.

name: novel-bump
description: 评分公式升级。当校准数据积累到一定程度且出现系统性偏差时，提议并执行 rubric 维度/权重调整。最高风险动作，需全量重打分验证。

name: novel-canon
description: Maintain a novel project's canon, tentative facts, proposals, rejected ideas, and archived history without silently overwriting confirmed story truth. Use when recording story facts, accepting or rejecting state changes, resolving contradictions, or deciding whether a draft change becomes canon.

name: novel-canon-gate
description: Novel canon/proposal branch guard. Use before editing or merging novel files to check branch, canon impact, review notes, and accepted decisions.

name: novel-causality-architect
description: 将已确认的小说意图卡、主体定义与核心角色设计组织为经作者确认的因果故事线，锁定触发事件、阶段目标、关键转折、危机、高潮选择、结局与支线功能。用于主体已明确、但故事仍像事件清单或需要证明每一步为何必然发生时；不用于 POV、信息披露顺序、场景分解或小说正文。

name: novel-causality-audit
description: Audit novel causal chains, character agency, costs and consequences. Use when a plot turn feels forced, a solution is unearned, actions have no aftermath or a scene seems redundant, while preserving deliberate coincidence, quiet emotional scenes and supported character mistakes.

name: novel-cell-cluster-biomarker-selection
description: Use when a novel/rare cell cluster discovery step (e.g., scNovel) has produced candidate clusters and you need disease-vs-control differential genes within those clusters, or consistent biomarkers across related novel subtypes.

name: novel-cell-detection-mode-ablation
description: Use when benchmarking or configuring scNovel for novel rare cell-type discovery and you must choose among its four detection score modes (S^MSP, S^ODIN, S^SEQ, S^SIM) using AUROC/AUPR/FPR95.

name: novel-cell-type-detection
description: Use when a labeled t0 scRNA-seq matrix has been cross-timepoint-annotated onto a t1 matrix (CrossTimeAnnotation) and you need to flag emerged/novel cell types or tumor subclones rather than force-assigning them known labels.

name: novel-cell-type-detection
description: Use when a pre-trained source model must annotate target scRNA-seq cells without access to source data, and the target may contain cell types absent from the source label set, with no user-specified threshold allowed.

name: novel-cell-type-discovery-in-cross-omics-integration
description: Use when integrating unpaired annotated scRNA-seq with unlabeled scATAC-seq (h5ad, gene activity matrices) and you suspect the target data contains cell types missing from the source annotations.

name: novel-cell-type-rejection-analysis
description: Use when a query scRNA-seq dataset (h5ad) may contain cell types absent from the curated reference, and you want annotation transfer to correctly reject those cells so the unassigned cluster can be characterized by marker genes.

name: novel-chapter
description: 核心章节写作循环。9 步管线：outline → user_confirm → memory_load → write → self_check → fix_loop → memory_update → checkpoint → user_review。当用户说"写第 X 章"、"写下一章"、"继续写"、"接着写"、"重写第 X 章"、"write chapter N" 时触发。两阶段温度策略：写作时高温，自检和修复时低温。

name: novel-chapter
description: 创建和修改单章正文（含番外/楔子，不占主线章号）。两种模式：一句话快速模式（用户一句话 + 章纲补全或生成 → 骨架审核 → 写完整章节 → 自检 → 用户确认定稿），互动式模式（模拟剧情进行，agent 写场景段落，用户选择走向推进剧情，中间穿插选择/问答 → 逐段积累成章 → 收尾 → 用户确认）。还支持改稿、补写、查看骨架等操作。涉及正文创作、修改、审阅时使用。

name: novel-chapter
description: 小说章节主控技能，负责从场景规划、成稿、评估到定向修订的整章工作流

name: novel-chapter
description: 章节与单节撰写流程。章前卡 → 节表 → 节前卡 → 节初稿 → 八股检测 → 章后复盘。适用于用户说"写第 N 章"或 "/nwrite" 时。

name: novel-chapter-character
description: **版本**: 2.0 **功能**: Step 4.3 - 人物配置

name: novel-chapter-distillation
description: Distill a long novel chapter by chapter into a reusable skeleton before deeper analysis. Use when the user wants every chapter compressed into core progression, state change, structural function, and hook so later protagonist, opening, outline, and highlight skills can validate against a stable backbone and recalibrate mid-project without drifting too far from the source.

name: novel-chapter-draft
description: 小说章节正文生成。用于基于细纲、世界观、人物关系、风格规则和章节计划生成正文，并输出可追踪的状态增量，适合 chapter-first-draft、chapter-assistant 任务。

name: novel-chapter-drafter
description: Use when drafting full-length chapters or multi-chapter batches — autonomously ingests story-state.md, story-bible.md, and prior manuscript files to compose cohesive 2,500–4,500 word chapters with Deep POV, sensory immersion, and subtextual dialogue.

name: novel-chapter-frame
description: **版本**: 2.0 **功能**: Step 4.2 - 章纲构思

name: novel-chapter-outline
description: Use when decomposing structural acts into granular, chapter-by-chapter roadmaps — defines chapter goals, points of view, scene/sequel balance, emotional shifts (+/-), and irresistible cliffhangers or thematic resonances.

name: novel-chapter-plan
description: Plan a novel chapter from approved outline scope and current state. Use when deciding chapter function, scene sequence, tension and aftermath, reveal budget or chapter stopping conditions without recycling the same cliffhanger or treating target changes as actual events.

name: novel-chapter-plan
description: 单章场景规划与写作备忘。用于规划章节目标、场景顺序、读者期待、承接伏笔、情绪变化、断章点和写作注意事项，适合 chapter-scene-plan、chapter-memo、plot-thread-detect、chapter-summarize 任务。

name: novel-chapter-planner
description: Plans or revises one volume's chapter batches in its persistent Creator workspace. Use after volume approval; each requested batch contains at most six chapters.

name: novel-chapter-revision
description: 章节工艺优化核验 Skill。 用于对已落盘或用户提供的章节正文做"工艺级"修改核验， 按 `原文 / 建议改为 / 修改理由` 三段格式输出可裁决的修改清单。 不写正文、不替用户改文件，只产出修改建议，等用户逐条裁决（✅/❌/✏️）后再统一改稿。 触发条件： - "核查/核验第X章" - "优化第X章" - "看一下这一章的工艺问题" - "对这段做工艺核验" - 用户贴出一整章正文或一大段文本要求修改建议 - "继续优化第十三章"等续作场景 禁止触发的反例： - 用户只要"生成"或"创作"新章节正文 → 路由到 novel_generate_chapter - 用户只要"总结/汇报" → 不进入本 Skill 的逐条核验模式

name: novel-chapter-sop
description: Use during Phase 2 novel writing when user is drafting a chapter or scene - scene-level 8-step workflow requiring at least two rounds of independent agent review until no P0/P1 remains

name: novel-chapter-update
description: **版本**: 2.0 **功能**: Step 4.7 - 记忆更新

name: novel-chapter-write
description: **版本**: 2.0 **功能**: Step 4.4 - 正文生成

name: novel-chapter-write
description: 长篇小说章节正文 Skill。根据已确认的章节线路，完成指定章节正文。支持三种工作模式：生成草稿、局部修订、确认定稿。首次写作通过阶段零锁定全书固定风格（9维度分析+风格宪法），第1章到最后一章风格统一。输出为可直接复制粘贴的干净文本格式。输出到 {项目根目录}\{项目名}\08_章节正文\。

name: novel-chapter-writer
description: 指导小说《修仙：我的灵海有AI大模型》章节撰写，根据设定大纲、行文规范、已有正文生成符合风格的章节内容。当用户要求撰写或修改小说章节时调用。

name: novel-chapters
description: Write, draft, or improve full novel chapters with controlled POV, specific prose, causal scene movement, stable voice, and publishable craft. Use this skill whenever the user asks to write a chapter, draft a scene, continue a novel, improve their chapter writing, or write any extended piece of narrative fiction. Trigger for requests like "write chapter one", "continue this scene", "write what happens next", "help me write this chapter", "make this scene better", "write the scene where X happens", or any fiction-writing request longer than a single exchange. If prose narrative is being written…

name: novel-char-count
description: Count characters in novel Markdown using tools/novel_char_count.py (Unicode NFC code points, UTF-8).

name: novel-character
description: 小说角色档案管理工具。管理角色卡、言行一致性检测、关系图谱、角色弧线、出场统计。当用户需要创建/编辑角色、查看角色档案、检测角色言行一致性、管理角色关系、追踪角色成长时使用。触发词：角色、人物、角色卡、档案、言行一致、OOC检测、关系网、角色弧线。

name: novel-character
description: Maintain novel character identity, motivations, dynamic states and voices. Use when creating characters, checking a scene against injuries, relationships or knowledge, tracking promises and possessions, or testing whether a choice is supported by prior character development.

name: novel-character
description: 人物深度塑造 — 三幕弧光、Want vs Need 模型、致命缺陷设计、配角功能分类、对话潜台词三层冲突

name: novel-character
description: 人物圣经。基于 11 节（0-10）人物卡模板创建/完善人物卡片，含核心命题、弧光设计、关键台词与瞬间、哲学维度。适用于用户说"创建人物"、"完善角色"、"补人物卡"时。

name: novel-character
description: 人物塑造（镂尘）：人物档案卡、欲望与恐惧、缺陷与弧光、反派逻辑、关系网。建人物、写人设、设计反派与人物弧光时使用。

name: novel-character-agency
description: 设计或审读小说人物的欲望、主动选择、声口、群像差异和成长连续性。适用于人物扁平、配角工具化、成长后无趣、人物档与正文不一致；不替代完整剧情规划。

name: novel-character-arc
description: Novel character arc/web design. Use to create or review desire, need, ghost, false belief, contradictions, arc type, relationships, and voice cues.

name: novel-character-arc
description: 小说人物、人设与关系弧光。用于设计主角欲望和缺陷、配角功能、反派魅力、人物关系、组织关系、群像分工、成长线和 OOC 检查，适合 character-card、character-enhance、relation-enhance、spiral-expand 任务。

name: novel-character-architect
description: Use when designing complex, psychologically coherent characters — constructs the Want vs. Need engine, the Lie They Believe, the Origin Wound (Ghost), internal contradictions, and foil dynamics to sustain narrative arcs.

name: novel-character-consistency
description: Retrieve and maintain character consistency in novel generation by querying Milvus for all passages mentioning a character. Ensures character traits, appearance, relationships, and voice remain consistent across thousands of tokens. Use when continuing a story, introducing recurring characters, or when the model generates new scenes involving existing characters.

name: novel-character-design
description: 网文人设与群像工程。当用户需要设计主角性格、塑造配角功能、构建反派魅力、设计人物关系、规划人物弧光时触发。覆盖60+主角性格标签、30+配角功能模型、20+反派塑造模板，以及人物关系范式与弧光设计方法。

name: novel-character-designer
description: 撰写小说 LLD 阶段**角色详细设计**的专用技能。输入 HLD §2（角色系统 + 弧线 + 命名）及 §10（风格与用语规范），输出每个角色的**完整设计档案**（10 节标准结构——无层级区分）。

name: novel-character-graph
description: Professional long-form novel analysis and character relationship mapping + theme song generation. Automatically handles GBK/UTF-8 encoding, multi-GB file chunking, chapter-by-chapter incremental parsing, supports TXT/EPUB/PDF/DOCX novel formats. Outputs complete character system, relationship maps, worldviews, weapon/item systems, interactive visualization HTML, and AI-generated theme songs (Suno). Use when users ask for: novel analysis, character mapping, relationship graphs, worldview architecture, story timeline organization, manga/comic adaptation settings, novel theme song, ending song,…

name: novel-character-interviewer
description: 通过小步、确认式作者访谈，将小说原始 idea、意图卡和主体定义转化为可驱动选择的核心角色设计，锁定动机、形成原因、矛盾、压力反应、关系动力、变化边界与表达指纹。用于主体已明确但开发者仍无法预测角色为何和如何选择时；不用于角色扮演式代答、人物百科、因果事件设计、叙述契约、场景或小说正文。

name: novel-character-profile
description: character.md を作成・更新・点検するときに、登場人物プロフィールを `- **ラベル**:` 形式で揃え、_how_to/character_checklist.yaml と tools/novel_character_md_check.py で構造 lint する。

name: novel-character-relationships
description: 面向各种题材中文小说的通用创作、续写、润色与自检 Skill。以「叙事语义单元分段法」为最高优先级行文规则，保持事件、观察、因果、心理活动和对白的自然段完整性；兼顾人物独立人格、成熟伴侣互动、自然幽默和非说教式收尾。不绑定特定作品世界观。

name: novel-character-system-designer
description: 根据冻结的故事线、世界、环境和事件模型解析角色槽，定义每个人物的故事位置、活动参与、个体画像、责任、能动选择、人物弧与三层关系网络。用于自主构思 V2 的 C1 阶段；不修改上游模型，不开发场景、章节、正文或完整人物传记。

name: novel-character-voice
description: Design or revise distinct character voices for a novel using attention, word domains, syntax, social strategies and pressure variants. Use when dialogue sounds interchangeable, a speaker drifts from approved voice anchors, or creating a public voice profile without changing facts or inventing stereotyped catchphrases.

name: novel-character-writer
description: 将 LLD 角色详细设计 + HLD §10 小说风格与用语规范，转化为**可直接嵌入小说的 prose 素材**。

name: novel-characters
description: 从小说或短故事里拆出角色表、人物画像、形象提示词、音色提示词， 其中形象提示词含一张角色设定图的完整版面指令（左半身像 + 右全身三视图 + 细节条）， 产出 JSON + Markdown + 可交互的 report.html。 报告语言可指定（--lang），默认中文，任意语言都支持；零依赖、零 API key、不出图。 Use when asked to 拆小说角色、分析人物、生成角色卡、character sheets from a novel。

name: novel-characters
description: 从故事中整理人物身份、关系、外观和声线设计，产出角色卡、图像提示词与评审报告，可按需生成设定图。用于角色分析、人物画像和角色母本；短剧制作中按已批准大纲与当前批次选角。

name: novel-characters
description: name: novel-characters description: | 从小说或短故事里拆出角色设定集：人物画像、形象提示词（英文）、音色提示词、 角色设定图构图提示词，产出 cast.json + Markdown，用 directorx_bible 钉到画布评审。 零依赖 Node 脚本做分块/归并/合成/校验/渲染，质量门是代码检查；设定图可选， 走影棚生成工具（占位先行）。触发场景：拆小说角色、人物画像、角色卡、三视图设定、 小说选角、character sheets from a novel。 allowed-tools: - Read - Write - Bash - Task - Glob triggers: - novel-characters - 拆小说角色 - 人物画像 - 角色卡 - 三视图设定 - 小说选角 - character sheets - charac

name: novel-characters

description: LLM 连通性自检：对默认模型与各角色模型做一次最小真实调用，逐一报告 provider/model 是否真的可用。触发：「检查 LLM 能不能用」「测试模型连通」「创作前先确认配置」「为什么一调用就报错」，排查代理未启动 / key 失效 / base_url 写错时使用。

name: novel-check
description: 自洽性 & 完整性主控检查。聚合 8 大检查维度（角色互动/角色一致性/主线对齐/价值观对齐/时间·量纲/完整性/伏笔/哲学深度），调用多个 agent 协同作战，输出"通过/有条件通过/不通过"三档结论。适用于用户说"check一下"、"自洽性检查"、"完整性检查"、"是不是符合最初设定"时。这是 novel-continuity 的**升级主控版本**。

name: novel-checkpoint
description: Save and restore a resumable checkpoint for a novel project after a task, scene, chapter, or writing phase. Use when finishing a writing session, switching tasks, pausing automation, or recovering from a previous session without losing story state or pending decisions.

name: novel-claude-ai
description: 中文长篇小说全流程创作技能（v1.0.0）。当用户想写小说、创作故事、续写章节、构思剧情、搭建世界观、设计人物关系、提取写作风格、仿写其他小说时，必须使用本技能。覆盖从模糊想法到300万字成品的完整链路：脑洞引导、知识图谱构建、大纲管理、分镜写作、质量门禁、跨Agent审核、风格校准、中途改纲级联更新。即使用户只是说"帮我写个故事"或"我有个小说的想法"，也应触发本技能。

name: novel-cli-help
description: Answer Novel Code CLI usage, configuration, and troubleshooting questions. Use when user asks about Novel Code CLI installation, setup, configuration, slash commands, keyboard shortcuts, MCP integration, providers, environment variables, how something works internally, or any questions about Novel Code CLI itself.

name: novel-cli-step
description: Codex adapter: run ONE `novel` step via instruction packet (next → instructions → dispatch agent), then stop for human review (no auto-commit).

name: novel-climax
description: Plan a powerful climax for a novel. Use this skill when the user wants to plan their novel's climax, write the ending, design the final confrontation, figure out how to resolve their story, make their ending more satisfying, or needs help with the culmination of their plot. Also use when someone's ending feels anticlimactic, rushed, or unsatisfying, or when they need to connect their climax to character motivations and desires.

name: novel-clue-distribution
description: Plan and audit clue distribution across loaded novel chapters using surface functions, varied carriers, evidence windows and reveal dependencies. Use when clues feel too concentrated, conspicuous, repetitive or missing, while preserving intentional motifs and distinguishing planned clues from actual prose.

name: novel-cn
description: 当用户要创作中文长篇或中篇小说（网文、都市、悬疑、科幻、言情等）时使用，覆盖世界观、人物卡、大纲、风格卡和逐章正文；每章开头回读设定与前情摘要，解决长篇连载中的上下文丢失与文风漂移。非虚构长文档用 long-doc-cn。

name: novel-cocreate
description: 共创规划：与 AI 多轮对话澄清需求，逐轮累积出一份整本书的创作指令，定稿后可直接进入创作。触发：「还没想清楚写什么」「帮我把想法理清楚」「一起策划一本书」「共创」，冷启动、需求模糊时用它而非一次性 --prompt。

name: novel-comic-drama-director

name: novel-comic-drama-director
description: Convert Chinese novel files or chapter text into production-ready vertical manga-drama episodes with source-faithful splitting, reusable character and location assets, bounded LLM planning, reference-audio video generation, multi-speaker TTS, final subtitle burn-in, ASR, and deterministic media gates. Use for novel-to-video planning or implementation, character/location asset design, storyboards, model-neutral pipeline integration, manga-drama batch production, or repairing repeated shots, inconsistent characters, mismatched speech, and subtitle failures.

name: novel-comic-drama-preproduction
description: 把授权小说按卷整理为忠于原著、经审批且可直接进入视频生产的剧本、角色场景资产、导演分镜和 Prompt；适用于长篇与无限流小说改编，不负责实际视频生成。

name: novel-commercialization
description: 网文商业化与平台特化。当用户需要选择发布平台、了解平台风格、设计变现模式、规划签约策略时触发。覆盖起点/番茄/飞卢/晋江/七猫/新媒体文等平台详细对比，以及付费vs免费、IP改编等商业化设计。

name: novel-commit
description: 정고(확정) 트랜잭션 — 신규 사실 추출 제안 후 원고·원장·캐시를 git 커밋 하나로 원자 등록한다. --amend로 committed 화 수정. "N화 확정", "/novel-commit"에 사용.

name: novel-compliance
description: 网文敏感词规避与合规。当用户需要了解平台审核规则、规避敏感词、确保内容合规、了解违规判定标准时触发。覆盖各平台审核规则、敏感词库、违规内容判定、章节审核流程、2026年法规要求。

name: novel-concept-brief
description: Novel concept/premise/theme brief. Use to turn rough ideas into one-sentence premise, reader promise, genre angle, and files to update.

name: novel-conception-autonomous
description: 将已批准的完整小说构思访谈结果生产化为 V2 小说构思机器包、人类评审片段和 HTML，并在外部作者决定后生成最终开发准入或确定性返工路由。用于从访谈结果开始运行或恢复完整 B0→S1→W1→E1→T1→C1→Q1→P1→H1 构思链；不得使用旧 D1/R1 路径。

name: novel-conception-deliverable-assembler
description: 将通过独立 Q1 审查的作者控制基线、故事线、世界、环境、事件和角色 canonical 模型确定性组装为机器可消费的小说构思交付包。用于自主构思 V2 的 P1 阶段；不生成新构思、不修复上游、不写小说片段或 HTML。

name: novel-conception-fragment-writer
description: 读取自主构思 V2 中同一次 H1 运行的 current P1、正式 H1-A review plan 与 planned workspace，通过受控 Agent 的三阶段挑战和写作，交付固定中文文风、第三人称受限视角、非权威的小说评审样片。用于 H1-B；不写最终章节、不补充控制事实、不修改构思、不组装人审报告。

name: novel-conception-human-review-assembler
description: 将已验收的小说构思 P1 与样章片段组织成面向作者或编辑的十分钟构思评审内容，并生成可验证的 JSON、Markdown 和 H1 工作区状态。用于规划或组装世界设定、故事线、角色定义、样章四维人审报告；不用于修改构思本体、编写样章或渲染 HTML。

name: novel-conception-presentation-fidelity-reviewer
description: 独立审查小说构思的人审内容是否忠实、完整且不越权地呈现同一 P1 机器构思包，并生成可被 H1-A 组装硬门消费的语义一致性审查。用于人审报告候选已确定、正式组装发布之前；不修改构思、报告、样章或 HTML。

name: novel-conception-review-html-generator
description: 将正式 H1 人审内容模型确定性渲染为离线、安全、可访问、可打印且面向作者或编辑的小说构思 HTML 报告。用于呈现世界设定、故事线设计、角色定义和样章；不用于修改构思、重写片段、公开机器审计证据或记录作者决定。

name: novel-conception-reviewer
description: 独立审查自主构思 V2 的故事线、世界、环境、事件和角色五个 canonical 模型，验证跨域覆盖、因果、状态、真实性、人物能动性、主题支撑和开发可用性，并确定性给出 ready、revise 或 blocked。用于 Q1 技术审查；不修改模型、不生成新故事答案、不组装交付物或人审报告。

name: novel-confirmation
description: 作品确认——确定书名、简介、封面方向等作品基本信息

name: novel-conflict-designer
description: 毒点避坑与冲突设计技能。触发关键词：毒点、冲突设计、避坑、打脸、节奏。当用户说这些词时自动触发。功能：检测小说毒点、设计冲突节奏、规划打脸剧情、提供情绪调动技巧。

name: novel-consistency-guards
description: Use throughout Phase 2 novel writing as a background guardrail - hard constraint scanning, cross-chapter consistency tables, hook-vs-body parity check - activated alongside chapter-sop and finalization

name: novel-context
description: Assemble a minimal, task-specific context packet from a novel project's canon, plans, drafts, reviews, and checkpoints. Use before drafting, planning, reviewing, revising, or resuming work so the AI reads relevant state without loading the entire novel indiscriminately.

name: novel-continue
description: Continue writing from existing novel content, following the original settings (character relationships, background, personality, plot direction), reasonably introducing new characters and storylines, focusing on detailed descriptions and character psychology, and employing rhetorical techniques to enhance drama.

name: novel-continue-chapter
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "continue writing", "next chapter", "keep writing", "resume the story", "write the next chapter", or wants to continue a story from where it left off. This is Procedure

name: novel-continuity
description: Keep the story consistent: extract canon facts after drafting, check scenes and chapters against Canon, the timeline, character knowledge, injuries, objects, and locations, and log or repair contradictions. Load this after drafting or revising a scene or chapter, before a continuity or copy pass, when the author asks 'is this consistent', 'did I contradict myself', 'check the timeline', or when runStoryLint reports chronology, knowledge, location, or POV issues.

name: novel-continuity
description: 소설 원고와 story-bible를 대조해 인물 지식, 소품, 시간축, 연도/나이, 복선 회수, 설정 모순만 점검한다. 기본적으로 원고를 고치지 않는다(critique). 트리거: 연속성, 모순, continuity, 설정 충돌, story bible, 타임라인, 복선, 떡밥, 회수, foreshadowing, 나이, 연도. 집필 novel-writing, 퇴고 book-editing(소설), 보이스 novel-voice.

name: novel-continuity
description: 一致性校验。跨章扫描设定/人物/时间/地点冲突，生成冲突清单。适用于用户说"检查设定冲突"、"前后矛盾"、"做一致性审校"时。

name: novel-continuity
description: 长篇连贯性管理：状态台账、滚动摘要、前情提要、分批生产与收束规则。写长篇、连载续写、管理几十万字以上作品的一致性时使用。源自 200 万字级长篇的实产流程。

name: novel-continuity-audit
description: Audit novel continuity against source records and actual prose. Use when checking injuries, possessions, knowledge, relationships, chronology, world limits or revisions for contradictions without treating rumors, plans or deliberate lies as confirmed truth.

name: novel-continuity-audit
description: Novel continuity/canon audit. Use before accepting a proposal or after drafting to find timeline, knowledge, object, POV, relationship, and world-rule conflicts.

name: novel-continuity-checker
description: Use when auditing chapters for factual inconsistencies, timeline contradictions, character physical drift, inventory leaks, and magic rule violations — compares draft text against the canonical Story Bible.

name: novel-continuity-review
description: Use when a fiction draft may contain character-state, timeline, location, or rule conflicts and must be checked against canon before approval.

name: novel-contract-patterns
description: Expert-level reference for modern Solidity contract patterns. Each section covers the canonical implementation, subtle correctness constraints, and security pitfalls that appear in audit findings.

name: novel-control-station
description: Use when writing, planning, continuing, repairing, revising, or running marathon/"疯狂写作"/auto continuation mode for Chinese long-form fiction with recurring characters, multiple plotlines, persistent world rules, chapter-by-chapter continuity needs, or style-specific constraints.

name: novel-coordinator
description: 统筹小说创作全流程，管理各智能体协作和任务分配，维护项目状态和文档版本

description: 长篇小说全自动写作助手 v5.0：给一个开头自动成书。发散→评分→选择→写作→校验，循环不停。23大模块 + 8维方向评分 + 7维章后评分 + 记忆锚点污染 + D15反常配角驱动 + 卷终反转引擎 + 双重写入策略 + 禁用技术向隐喻。30万字不崩盘，每章都有爽点和画面。

name: novel-copy-edit
description: Mechanical copy edit of a revised manuscript: spelling of names and invented terms, capitalization, tense, punctuation, dialogue formatting, numbers and dates, and consistency with Canon and the Glossary — using grep-proven, exact edits. Load this for a copy edit or proofread, 'fix typos', 'check consistency of names', before export, or after line revision.

name: novel-core
description: 当用户使用 /novel-core，或请求写长篇网文、开书、规划剧情、写章节、审稿、去AI味、人性化润色、分析题材参考时使用。该 skill 是 novel-harness 工程的启动入口，会加载 .harness/agents/总编Agent.md，并按 .harness/agents/ 路由到规划、写作、审稿、上下文 Agent。

description: 网文项目的目录约定、文件格式、章节命名（含番外 NNNNx 锚定规则）、设定文件模板、memory 连续性台账同步规程，以及 novel.py 工具（建目录/下一章/字数统计/格式与AI味检查/正文检索/整本切章/插章重编号/番外位）。凡是在小说项目里读写正文、设定、大纲、伏笔、摘要文件，或者要知道“某个东西该放哪、该怎么写格式”，都先读这个技能；其它 novel-* 技能都依赖它。

name: novel-core

name: novel-core-character-framer
description: Use when a novel proposal needs core character roles, relationship frame, or minimal character functions.

name: novel-core-concept-designer

name: novel-corpus-indexer

AUTOMATICALLY ACTIVATE when the user says anything like "make a cover art prompt", "generate a cover art for my novel", "create a book cover prompt", "prompt for cover art", "I need cover art", "design the cover", "cover illustration prompt", or "visual for the book". Output is compatible with ChatGPT Image, Midjo…

name: novel-cover-layout
description: cover.yaml の編集・book_cover_review・lock・book_export による reader-proof 生成と _meta.md §3.1／§7 の同期を行う。題字は組版 text または logo_asset。

name: novel-cover-prompt
description: 小说封面提示词设计。用于根据书名、作者名、题材、平台、主角气质、核心卖点和视觉风格生成网文封面 prompt，不直接调用图像 API，适合封面工作台和 cover 类请求。

Use when planning an arc, planning or drafting a chapter, fixing weak scenes or flat dialogue, choosing genre conventions, or auditing a draft before review. 中文长篇的画面、结构、人物、伏笔与文风手艺。

name: novel-craft
description: Comprehensive craft reference for fiction writers. Covers genre conventions for sci-fi, fantasy, romance, erotica, and literary drama; what makes prose work at the sentence level; and what prose patterns to avoid (purple prose, filter words, passive voice, telling not showing, clichés, adverb overuse). Load when advising on genre requirements, critiquing prose quality, explaining craft principles, or answering questions about how to write a specific genre well.

name: novel-craft
description: Novel craft for scenes and chapters. Use when writing a chapter, building a scene, outlining beats, revising story architecture, or elevating a draft.

name: novel-craft
description: 中文网文正文写作指导：实时场景构建、段落与排版规范（拒绝一句一行碎段与密排文字墙）、对白与群像调度、视角控制、写出人味、去除两代 AI 味（网文套话 + 大模型端腔/旁白解说腔/伪金句/破折号补刀/死比喻），以及 8 种文风预设。只要是在写、改、润色、扩写、续写小说正文，或者用户抱怨“AI 味重”“文笔难看”“像流水账/解说词”“格式难看”，都必须使用这个技能。

name: novel-crawler

Use only for a sealed HP1 work-order. Never add, repair, reinterpret, summarize away, or revise story semantics.

name: novel-hld-presentation-fidelity-reviewer
description: Independently review a sealed HH1-A human-review report against its bound HP1 HLD package for omission, weakening, enhancement, misattribution, visual-data drift, twenty-four-minute budget, and fixed decision retrieval. Use only from an HH1-B work order with a different task identity from the assembler. This skill never edits the report, judges story quality, reads HTML, or certifies rendering accessibility.

name: novel-hld-review-report-assembler
description: Assemble the HH1-A human-review report JSON from a sealed HP1 HLD package after HQ2 passes. Use when an author needs a conclusion-first, fully source-bound HLD review path within twenty-four minutes. This thinking-dominant skill may organize and compress HP1 conclusions, but must not add, repair, weaken, or reinterpret HLD content, judge story quality, prove its own fidelity, or render HTML.

name: novel-hld-rhythm-continuity-architect
description: Design the HR1 canonical story-time, narrative-order, duration-density, space-transition, synchronization, pacing, tension, recovery, and continuity architecture inside the novel HLD harness. Use only from a sealed HR1 work order with current HB0 through HI1 completions; preserve upstream causality and world facts, and never invent locations, exact prose timing, transition actions, or scene schedules.

name: novel-hld-semantic-reviewer
description: 独立审查小说 HLD 的完整性、一致性、因果与现实可行性。仅在 novel-hld-autonomous 的 HQ1 阶段使用；读取 HB0、HA1–HK1 与 HD1 已验收公共包，输出证据绑定的审查结论，不修改上游 HLD，也不决定返工路由。

name: novel-hld-storyline-choreographer
description: Build HS1's complete multi-storyline choreography from current HB0 and HA1 packages. Use only when novel-hld-autonomous issues an HS1 work order to identify authoritative storylines, segment and place them in HA1 units, define typed connections and activation dispositions, and prove the story subject can be reconstructed. Do not invent story facts, character arcs, POV, pacing, scenes, or prose.

name: novel-hld-workflow
description: Use when an accepted PRD package must become a novel HLD world-system contract before LLD work begins.

name: novel-hld-writer
description: This file is a historical reference only. It is not an authoritative HLD entry point.

name: novel-humanizer
description: 小说去AI味质检工具。检测AI味、时代错位、角色OOC、系统面板化、情感直给、对话机械等问题，提供评分和人化改写。当用户需要检测章节质量、去除AI味、修正时代错位、优化文学性时使用。触发词：质检、去AI味、人化、评分、检测、改写、时代错位、OOC、文学性、AI味。

name: novel-humanizer-universal
description: Kỹ năng sáng tác, viết tiếp, viết lại và QC tiểu thuyết/truyện dài thuộc mọi thể loại. Chủ động thích ứng giọng văn, kết cấu, nhịp kể, điểm nhìn và mức độ biên tập theo chỉ dẫn, mẫu văn và phản hồi của tác giả; bảo toàn canon; tự học/lưu phong cách theo mức cho phép; rà soát continuity/logic lũy tích từ chương đầu sau MỖI chương.

name: novel-idea
description: Generate a compelling idea for a novel. Use this skill when the user wants to brainstorm, develop, or refine a novel idea, pick a concept for their book, figure out what to write about, choose a genre, or needs help deciding on a premise for fiction writing. Also use when someone says they want to write a novel but don't know what about, or when they're evaluating whether their idea is strong enough.

name: novel-idea-exploration
description: 灵感探索。与用户一起探索题材、灵感、粗略剧情或模糊世界观；当输入还不足以确定简介、主角定位和最小 lorebook 骨架、无法进入 novel-setup 时使用。

name: novel-idea-hunter
description: Evidence-first opportunity discovery — finds novel, defensible product/startup/project opportunities by researching before ideating, and mechanically rejects generic "AI-powered X" slop with deterministic validators. Use whenever the user asks for startup ideas, product or business opportunities, "what should I build", niche discovery, idea validation, opportunity research in a domain, or wants ideas that aren't generic AI slop — even if they don't name this skill. This is a heavyweight multi-phase research workflow with web searches and validator scripts; for a throwaway one-line brainstorm,…

name: novel-ideation
description: Use during Phase 1 of novel writing when user is brainstorming theme, characters, worldview - activated by novel-writer-workflow-guide when user signals early ideation phase

name: novel-image-layout
description: 作品フォルダ内で tag/<romaji>/（キャラ画像）、manga/_assets/<manga_XX>/comic/（漫画・コマ画像）、 manga/_assets/<manga_XX>/pages/（漫画・ページ画像）、manga/_assets/<manga_XX>/backgrounds/（背景資料）、 manga/_assets/<manga_XX>/names/（ネーム画像）、manga/_assets/<manga_XX>/assembled/（組んだ PSD）、illustrations/_assets/<illustration_XX>/（挿絵・表紙）のディレクトリを tools/novel_image_layout.py で一括作成・パス列挙する。 Forge txt2img の output_dir と組み合わせる。

name: novel-impact-review
description: Review downstream effects of a novel revision using explicit record references and loaded prose. Use before canon retcons, changing key facts, revising a clue or promise, or synchronizing character states, timeline, plans and later chapters without claiming unseen material has been verified.

name: novel-import
description: 导入已有小说到项目结构。逆向解析，生成设定、大纲、追踪文件。 触发方式：/novel-import、/导入、「把我的书导进来」

name: novel-import
description: 导入现有小说 txt 的编排技能。两种模式：借设定重写（只把原作的世界观、设定、人物搬进 lore，原作不是正史，新书剧情从零创作、由用户定走向）和全文导入续改（原作全部入库成为正史，之后续写、改章、插章、分叉续写）。还负责导入后的结构操作：插入主线章重编号、插入番外、改动下游影响检查。用户说"导入小说""导入 txt""参考这本书写""续写这本书""在这本书基础上改"时使用。

name: novel-import-silly-tavern-card
description: Import local SillyTavern character cards, worldbooks, presets, MVU and prompt-template material into a NeuroBook Project Workspace. Use when the user asks to inspect, unpack, convert or import 酒馆角色卡 / SillyTavern cards for novel writing, lorebook migration, RP or world simulation.

name: novel-import-tomato-reference
description: 用于处理番茄小说、Tomato Novel Downloader、免费小说 epub、下载器结果导入、epub 转 Markdown、以及把外部小说素材整理到当前小说 Project Workspace 的 reference/tomato/ 供后续拆书分析。

name: novel-information
description: Maintain author truth, character beliefs, reader evidence and reveal permissions for a novel. Use when checking viewpoint leaks, who knows what and when, dramatic irony, early reveals or preparing a spoiler-free context packet for drafting or reader hypothesis testing.

name: novel-init
description: **版本**: 2.0 **功能**: Step 0 - 项目初始化

name: novel-init
description: 初始化新小说项目，建立目录结构和基础创作契约（CLAUDE.md）。触发词："初始化小说""新建项目""开始写小说""创建小说"。

name: novel-init
description: 初始化一个新长篇小说项目，生成 RTK.md / 小说大纲 / 章节大纲 / 前情梳理 / 伏笔清单 / 经典语录 / 人物档案 / 写作技巧 等核心资料骨架。触发词：初始化小说项目、新建长篇小说、novel-init、起一个新坑、建一个新故事、小说项目脚手架。

name: novel-init
description: 用于初始化一个新的小说项目。当用户说"我想写小说"、"开始写小说"、"新建小说项目"、"创建一本新小说"、"start a new novel" 时触发。会引导用户完成基本信息确认后，搭建标准的 vault 目录结构（story.md / characters / worldbuilding / plot / chapters / style / .memory），并可选地 git init。

name: novel-init
description: novel-forge 首次 onboarding 与项目脚手架创建。5 个问题建立创作者画像，然后生成完整项目结构。所有其他子 skill 在 .novel-state.json 不存在时自动路由到此。

name: novel-init
description: 새 웹소설 작품 프로젝트를 초기화한다. Q&A로 제목·장르·플랫폼·검토 기준 초기값을 정하고, 디렉토리 구조·novel-config.yaml·사실 원장 시드·git 저장소를 생성한다. 사용자가 "새 작품", "작품 프로젝트 초기화", "/novel-init"를 요청할 때 사용.

name: novel-init
description: 从一句话需求（或一份需求文件）初始化整本书的基础设定：前提、世界规则、日历、人物卡、故事线、指南针、首弧大纲、文风标准。完成后停下让用户审阅。

name: novel-init
description: 灵活的交互式建书工具：通过对话引导用户定义项目结构、设定分类、创作偏好、核心要素。不预设任何固定分类（如"门派""势力""物品"），而是询问用户"你的故事需要管理哪些设定？"让用户自己添加。支持边写边补充，所有结构都可动态调整。用户说"开新书""建书""初始化项目"或项目为空时使用。

name: novel-init
description: 初始化新小说的 workspace。创建目录结构、config.json、 大纲模板、角色档案模板。 触发条件: "创建新小说"、"新建项目"、"init novel"、"初始化小说"

name: novel-init-wizard
description: Use when creating a new fiction project through a deep planning interview, especially when the model should ask staged questions about genre, protagonist, world setup, conflict, and first-volume direction before creating the project.

name: novel-innovation
description: 网文创新、反套路与融合引擎。当用户需要创新写法、设计反套路、融合多种题材、植入热梗、规避AI写作陷阱时触发。覆盖类型融合相容性矩阵、30+反套路设计、2026网文趋势、AI辅助写作常见陷阱。

name: novel-insertion-variant-calling
description: Use when you have barcode-aware synthetic long-read data (10x Genomics Chromium, TELL-Seq, or stLFR) aligned to a reference genome such as GRCh38, and the goal is to discover non-reference sequence insertions >300 bp that short-read callers miss.

name: novel-insight-engine
description: Produce one genuinely novel, testable insight (not advice, summary, or conventional reframing) with mandatory prior-art comparison, falsifiability, structured z-mapping exploration, and adversarial self-critique before presentation. Use when the user wants a single sharp, surprising, falsifiable idea rather than a list of suggestions. Emphasizes depth, parameter discipline, and survival under attack.
allowed_tools: read_file, grep, list_dir, web_search, web_fetch, open_page, open_page_with_find, x_keyword_search, x_semantic_search, memory_search, memory_get, todo_write

name: novel-inspiration-ingest
description: 对话中所有信息储备的唯一入口。以下任一情况立即触发： 用户粘贴文本>200字 / 提供 .txt/.pdf/.docx/.epub 路径 / 提供 URL / 上传图片 / 手打描述（角色设定/章节内容/技法心得/灵感碎片）/ 触发短语：扔本书/看下这个/消化一下/吸收进设定/这个能不能用/学习这段写法/提炼技法/这段写得好/这个加进大纲。 内部按资料层次路由到：设定/*.md / 创作技法/ / .case-library/ / 章节大纲/*.md / 总大纲.md。 注意：批量外部小说库提炼（case_builder.py）是独立离线任务，不经过本 skill。

name: novel-intake
description: Turn an author's brainstorm, notes, pitch, or loose idea into a precise Brief & Contract doc — premise, promises, tone, ending shape, length target, and numbered drift criteria — plus project metadata and logline, without silently erasing the author's constraints. Load this when starting a new novel project, when the author says 'read my brainstorm/notes', 'here's my idea', 'begin planning', or when a project has notes but no Brief & Contract yet.

name: novel-intake-boundary-ledger-builder
description: Use when a novel proposal task needs the intake brief converted into enforceable constraints and open-question boundaries.

name: novel-intake-workflow
description: Use when a human novel idea, early notes, or reference preferences must be clarified before proposal work begins.

name: novel-integration-merge
description: 用 Novel 的 fix/niudieyi-merge-issue 过渡分支处理开发或功能分支合入 dev/test 的冲突。用于“走过渡分支合 dev/test”“重置到 origin/dev 或 origin/test 后合源分支并强推”等完整集成请求，也支持只报告冲突范围。不用于直接发布 dev/test/master 或普通功能分支同步。

name: novel-intent-facilitator
description: 通过小步、确认式访谈将小说灵感、简报或旧稿收拢为经作者确认的意图卡。用于构思的“收拢意图”步骤、项目方向不清或需要重新确认范围和硬约束时；不用于设计角色、完整情节、场景或小说正文。

name: novel-interview-b0-migrator
description: Build and finalize a hash-bound compatibility migration when a previously approved novel-conception interview chain (I0-I5, V1, V2 and its approval) predates the B0 control-projection and fact-dependency contracts. Use it to extract exact Markdown sections into B0-compatible controls and facts. Support either exhaustive migration review or an explicit author process decision delegating compatibility conversion while reserving human review for the final four-part conception report. Never revise story meaning, invent author approval, or create a B0 handoff.

name: novel-interview-brief-generator
description: 将已完成的小说意图、主体、角色、因果与叙述访谈产物汇总为供作者评审的独立 HTML 可视化简报。用于所有构思访谈完成、开发地图开始前，需要用三个高密度板块审查小说世界、故事线与人物定义/目标/职责/边界时；不用于补设定、改写因果、代替作者批准或生成小说正文。

name: novel-interview-integrity-auditor
description: 自主审计六份已完成的小说构思访谈产物是否覆盖方向、主体、世界、人物、因果和叙述控制点，且版本一致、可追溯并可交接作者评审。用于所有访谈完成、生成可视化简报之前；不发起创作访谈、不补设定、不替作者裁决。

name: novel-intron-chain-isoform-reconstruction
description: Use when long-read BAM/FASTQ alignments plus a reference annotation (e.g. GENCODE mm10 GTF) are available and the goal is to discover novel isoforms by requiring end-support from CAGE TSS and polyA site references before collapsing intron chains.

name: novel-isoform-model-merging-with-unique-ids
description: Use when region-split IsoQuant runs (distrreg, e.g. g5000000) produce separate per-region transcript reconstructions that must be combined into one coherent transcript model set for read assignment and counting.

name: novel-kit
description: Reliable long-form fiction work — drafting and editing novels. Use whenever a task involves writing a novel/chapter/scene, building a story/characters/plot, prose style or line-editing, continuity across a long manuscript, or critiquing fiction. Wraps the model's weak spots (praising its own prose without reading it cold, clichéd default phrasing, contradicting established canon over tens of thousands of words, structureless episodic scenes) in deterministic scanners + a design->draft->inspect->cold-read loop + a craft/failure learning system.

name: novel-knowledge
description: 小说知识库管理工具。管理时间线、物价锚点、流行文化、品牌对照、对标书、参考资料，支持Markdown+HTML双备份。当用户需要查询时代背景、验证物价合理性、管理设定知识、查证细节、管理对标书时使用。触发词：知识库、时间线、物价、时代背景、查证、品牌对照、对标书、参考资料。

name: novel-knowledge
description: 实体搜索、关系查询、标签查询、索引重建。其他 skill 的数据访问层。

name: novel-language-style
description: 网文语言与文风光谱。当用户需要调整文风、选择叙述视角、运用修辞技法、植入玩梗、增强画面感时触发。覆盖白描/华丽/口语化/文艺/中二/翻译腔/新媒体风等文风类型，以及特写/慢镜头/蒙太奇/空镜头/长镜头等画面感技术。

name: novel-learn
description: 学习本小说项目约定：声口、黑名单词、节奏阈值、读者反馈 → 写入 .cursorGrowth/learn/。不改 .cursor。用户说「记住」「学一下」「沉淀约定」或 /nlearn 时用。

name: novel-learn-from
description: 从对标作品/作者导入信号，拆解爆款模式，派生初始评分校准锚点。冷启动用户的第一信号来源。

name: novel-lessons-20260725
description: 深度审查后的写作经验与系统优化教训

name: novel-library
description: Organize multiple novel files into series, volume reading order and shared universes or continuities using the novel library CLI. Use before multi-file ingestion, not for extracting scenes or inventing story dates.

name: novel-library-batch-organizer
description: 批量整理本地小说库。先统一转码所有文件到 UTF-8 临时目录，再扫描分析、分层处理，最终输出到 NovelLibrary_Processed/ 保持原目录结构。

name: novel-light-continuity-sweep
description: Use near the end of a prose drafting pass to catch obvious local continuity issues. This is not a full canon audit or merge-safety review.

name: novel-line-revision
description: Sentence-level revision of drafted scenes or chapters: clarity, specificity, rhythm, repetition, filter words, narrative distance, dialogue, and voice consistency — through exact versioned edits that never change accepted story events. Load this when the author asks to polish, tighten, line edit, 'make the prose better', fix repetitive or flat writing, or after developmental revision is done.

name: novel-lld-writer
description: Create, revise, or review a novel LLD as a hard thinking skill. Use after a novel HLD exists to detail roles, spaces, route-node materials, scene blueprints, sensory states, behavior markers, and writing-ready settings without redefining PRD/HLD direction or writing prose.

name: novel-load-context
description: Use when drafting, planning, or reviewing a long-form fiction chapter and the model must load canon facts instead of relying on fragile prompt memory.

name: novel-logic
description: 小说逻辑预防工具。在写作过程中通过场景微逻辑卡、动作前四问、时间-地点双轴标注、信息边界追踪、冻结状态等机制，硬阻塞式预防时间矛盾、空间瞬移、信息穿帮、行为越界、因果断裂。当用户需要预防逻辑漏洞、检查前后一致性、管理角色知情边界、冻结前文章节状态时使用。触发词：逻辑、逻辑预防、微逻辑卡、四问、知情边界、时间地点、一致性、前后矛盾、信息边界、冻结状态、逻辑矩阵。

name: novel-lore
description: 交互式创建和修改小说设定（世界书）：角色、地点/地图、势力/宗门、物品/法宝/功法/丹药、力量体系、历史、种族、规则，以及伏笔/暗线设计和设定图（生成绘图提示词、归档参考图）。会检查新设定与已有设定、正文、时间线是否冲突，并同步术语表和关联实体。用户说“加个角色”“设计一个宗门/法宝/境界体系”“完善世界观”“给 xx 做个人设”“设计一条暗线”“出个立绘提示词”，或者写作中需要新的设定时使用。

name: novel-lore-bible
description: Use when creating, expanding, and curating the comprehensive project story bible — organizes relational character dossiers, world laws, chronological timelines, faction hierarchies, and thematic motifs into a single canonical source of truth.

name: novel-macro-structure-designer
description: Use when a novel proposal needs whole-work macro structure, part logic, act logic, or PRD-scope candidates.

name: novel-main
description: 番茄小说章节全流程创作 — 统筹调用所有子技能，按7步状态机完成从资料整理到备份的完整流程。支持中断恢复与自动/确认双模式

name: novel-manga-md-output
description: 漫画互換 manga/manga_XX.md をチャットや Write だけで書かず、 manga/pages/*.yaml を正本として novel_prompt_ir_export_md.py で必ず出力する。 「互換 MD 更新完了」の定義（export 実行＋Read 確認）は本スキルで固定する。 「これからエクスポートします」と述べたら宣言のみで終えず同一ターンでツール実行まで進める。

name: novel-market-analyst
description: Use to analyze commercial viability, reader demographics, and genre trends across physical print and digital novel platforms (Royal Road, Webnovel, Wattpad, Amazon KDP, KBM/Fizzo, Substack) — formulates platform positioning, monetization models, and conducts competitive market research.

name: novel-market-analyzer
description: 市场分析技能。触发关键词：市场分析、热门题材、番茄热门、选题分析、题材选择。当用户说这些词时自动触发。功能：分析番茄热门题材、判断题材热度、提供选题建议、分析竞品。

name: novel-market-scan
description: 网文市场扫描与平台趋势判断。用于分析番茄、起点、晋江、七猫、知乎盐言、短篇平台等榜单、题材风口、读者需求、平台适配和选题机会，适合立项前的 reference 阶段与 inspiration-pack、reference-deep-analyze 任务。

name: novel-master
description: 扮演世界顶级长篇小说作家兼资深网文编辑。精通男频/女频全类型，熟知各平台读者口味与爽点节奏。以**主角中心 + 适度群像**为核心叙事策略。

name: novel-master
description: 长篇小说创作大师技能。支持数百万字小说的整体规划、分卷设计、角色管理、世界观构建、章节写作、一致性检查和伏笔追踪。使用场景：(1) 创作长篇网络小说 (2) 规划多卷系列作品 (3) 管理复杂人物关系和剧情线索 (4) 保持长篇小说的一致性 (5) 生成章节内容 (6) 伏笔回收检查

description: 长篇小说AI分卷创作·五规范执行技能。基于持久化架构+防注水禁令+轻小说写作风格+日轻标点排版+ 异世界引擎指南，适配日本轻小说创作模式。管理全局文件体系+字数管控+三级大纲+10种注水检测+ 写作风格+标点段落+引擎选择。

name: novel-perspective
description: Choose the right perspective (POV) and tense for a novel. Use this skill when the user wants to decide between first person and third person, choose a narrative perspective, figure out their novel's point of view, understand the difference between omniscient and limited third person, fix head-jumping problems, or needs help with POV consistency. Also use when someone is struggling with whose eyes the reader should see through, or when they're mixing perspectives unintentionally.

name: novel-pipeline
description: 把各功能串成一条可恢复的流水线：（共创→）写作→评审→重写→交付，按阶段执行、断点续跑。触发：「一条龙写完整本书」「从头跑完整个流程」「中断后接着跑」，想要无人值守端到端、且能中断恢复时使用。

name: novel-pipeline
description: 用 AI 从零写一本中文长篇网络小说，并持续日更——作者可以完全从零（剧情交给 AI）、给点思路、或带着已有设定进来；立项和每 30 章的弧线大纲都会一次给几个版本供挑选，建成带分层记忆（故事圣经+硬约束/伏笔台账/弧线提要/弧线计划/摘要与近期原文）的项目，然后一章一章稳定续写几百章不走形，最后可选地自动发到番茄/七猫/17K/塔读。自带 37 个题材的写作模版（套路、开局钩子、带权重的评分维度、迭代过的写作细则），使用者不必自己建语料库。只要用户想写小说、开新书、续写、写下一章、搞大纲、立人物设定、让 AI 帮忙写长篇连载、问"怎么开始写"，或者说某一章读起来不对劲/想让人检查哪里有问题/要改稿，或者问某个题材的读者爱看什么、这个品类有什么套路，或提到 write_novel/review_loop/网文/日更/发章/上传章节，就使用这个 skill——哪怕只说"帮我写本小说"这种模糊说法也先读它，因为长篇一致性靠的是这套记忆结构，直接开聊写出来的章节到第二十章一定前后矛盾。**不要用在这些事上**：单篇文章、书评、读后感、睡前故事、翻译或润色；分析网文行业、平台榜单或版权合同；以及虽然提到小说但其实是写代码的活（切分 txt、小说站报错）。判断标准是：有没有一本要持续写很多章的书。

name: novel-pipeline
description: 全自动小说写作流水线——启动后自动调度10个子代理并行工作（写作+审计+修复+同步）， 持续产出章节直至目标章节数。v2 新增合规引擎：虚构化映射、免责声明、出版前审计。 触发词：写小说、继续扩展、流水线、自动写作、批量产出。

name: novel-pirate
description: 盗版网络小说检索与抓取：按书名找全文源（笔趣阁站群 / TXT 全集站 / EPUB 轻小说站 / 搜书引擎 / 网盘社群），抓章→清洗→出 TXT 与 EPUB；没有现成渠道时自建爬虫。批量正文清洗外包给 codex 的 gpt-6-luna，省主上下文 token。Use when 用户要 找小说、下载小说、抓小说、爬小说、要 TXT/EPUB、起点/菠萝包/番茄/刺猬猫/晋江 的书、笔趣阁、全本、盗版源、章节抓取。
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

name: novel-plan
description: 开一本新长篇前的"立项"流程。在动笔和 novel-init 之前，先把这本书必须提前想清楚的东西定下来：核心钩子 / 设定 / 升级套路 / 最终结局 / 分卷大纲 / 写作思路，并做设定压测。触发词：开新书立项、开书前想清楚、立项、写作思路、novel-plan、这本书怎么规划、新坑的顶层设计。
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, AskUserQuestion

name: novel-plan
description: Structured planning workflow for novelists. Guides a writer through identifying their writer type (plotter/pantser/plantser), choosing a planning framework (Three-Act Structure, Save the Cat 15-beat sheet, Snowflake Method, or Hero's Journey), building character arcs from a central Lie/Truth pair, establishing theme and inciting incident, and producing a scene-by-scene outline ready to draft from. Load when a writer is starting a new novel, is stuck before they've begun drafting, or needs to outline or restructure their story.

name: novel-plan

name: novel-plan-next

name: novel-planner
description: Plan novels with plot structure, character arcs, and world-building. TRIGGERS - Use when user needs help with novel-planner related tasks.

name: novel-planner
description: 长篇小说宏观规划技能。当用户想要开始创作一部长篇小说、需要构建叙事架构、规划章节大纲、分配情节节奏时，必须使用此技能。触发词包括：写小说、创作长篇、故事大纲、情节规划、三幕结构、章节设计、小说框架、叙事架构。即使用户只是说"我想写一个故事"或"帮我规划一下"也应触发此技能。

name: novel-planner
description: Plan story architecture at the granularity the project needs, register promises and dependencies, and enforce plan-first drafting. Use for saga, arc, volume, chapter, and scene planning, and before any substantial drafting begins.

name: novel-planning
description: 小说规划工作流——三级策划（世界观/人物 → 大纲 → 细纲）。含新书策划与已有书追加卷/补细纲。触发词："策划"、"规划"、"大纲"、"细纲"、"世界观"、"人物设定"、"开新书"、"追加卷"、"第X卷"、"补细纲"
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash, WebSearch, InvokeSkill, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite

name: novel-planning
description: 「一からストーリーを出して」「〇〇ものの話を考えて」など新しい物語案を出すとき、 および新規作品または既存作品の企画・設計フェーズで、proposal.md、 design_specification.md、config.md、character.md、world.md、_meta.md などを揃え、 執筆前確認へつなげる。資料不足時の作成順と確認観点を固定する。 ジャンル軸を判定し、該当する genre/ の葉を案出しの前に読む。 新規企画は Gate A / Gate B を完了する。既存作品の企画再開は Gate A で止め、 洗練または Gate B 再実施の明示時だけ Gate B まで進める。

name: novel-planning
description: 소설을 쓰기 전 소재, 장르, 인물, 플롯, 작업 단위를 정해 기획안과 씬 골격, 인계를 만든다. "소설 써줘" 요청에도 본문으로 직행하지 않는다. 트리거: 소설 기획, 소설 구상, 소재 발굴, 플롯, 인물 설계, 단편, 중편. 문체는 novel-voice, 집필은 novel-writing, 실용서 기획은 book-planning을 쓴다.

name: novel-platform
description: 番茄小说平台运营指南 — 推荐池机制、核心数据指标、日更节奏、存稿策略、读者互动话术、广告打断应对

name: novel-pleasure-points
description: 网文爽点模式大全与疲劳管理。当用户需要设计爽感、打脸桥段、逆袭高潮、金手指设定、装逼场景，或需要分析爽点心理机制、控制爽点密度、防止读者审美疲劳时触发。覆盖60+种爽点模式及其结构模板。

name: novel-plot
description: 管理小说情节结构 —— 卷纲、故事弧（arc）、时间线、伏笔账（hook ledger）。当用户说"做卷纲"、"设计故事弧"、"加伏笔"、"伏笔账"、"时间线"、"plot outline"、"design arc" 时触发。包含中文网文章节情节推进四大原则，以及借鉴 inkos hook-ledger 的 open/advance/resolve/defer 四态伏笔语义和"揭1埋1"硬底线。

name: novel-plot
description: Maintain novel plot threads, causal events and next-step progress. Use when designing a key event, checking motivation-action-consequence chains, identifying consequence-free conflicts, or revising a plot node while tracing downstream dependencies.

name: novel-plot
description: 单章剧情推演 — 基于大纲和创作上下文，推演本章核心冲突、事件节点、转折和章末钩子

name: novel-plot
description: 剧情大纲设计。基于 Logline 扩展为三幕结构、15 节拍及伏笔板。

description: 日本語Web小説の企画、プロット、読者への約束、ストーリー展開、キャラクター構造、タイトル・あらすじ、序盤設計、投稿サイト選定を壁打ちする相談専用Skill。「プロット相談」「企画会議」「この企画は勝てるか」「投稿サイト向けにストーリーやキャラを作りたい」「投稿先を選びたい」などの明示依頼で使う。本文執筆、作品ファイルの無断読込・更新、市場データの未確認な断定は行わない。

name: novel-plot-threads

Pulls story arcs, character conflicts, mysteries, and plot-critical information to prevent dropped storylines and ensure satisfying payoffs. Use when continuing the story, resolving conflicts, advancing plot arcs, or when model needs to remember what's at stake.

name: novel-polish
description: 已完成章节正文的质量检查和润色。四轮：工具检测 → AI味修复 → 一致性校验 → 独立润色。触发词："润色""polish""质检""检查""清理AI味""跑检测"。

name: novel-polishing

name: novel-storyline-architecture-designer
description: 将已批准的小说访谈控制基线设计为完整的多线故事架构，先建立统一时间主轴，再定义各故事线的职责、状态推进、连接点、关键转折、高潮、埋点、探针与回收，以及交给世界、环境、事件和角色阶段的硬需求。用于自主构思 V2 的 S1 阶段；不定义具体世界系统、环境、事件或人物档案。

name: novel-storyline-designer
description: Use when a novel proposal needs main, secondary, hidden, emotional, or thematic storyline design.

name: novel-storyline-quality-evaluator
description: Use when a proposal storyline, complete story synopsis, or main story chain needs subjective quality evaluation before proposal delivery.

name: novel-structural-editor
description: Use when executing developmental and structural manuscript audits — tracks setup-and-payoff matrices, audits Chekhov's guns, detects plot holes and motivational inconsistencies, and ensures thematic cohesion across the narrative arc.

name: novel-structure
description: Narrative structure knowledge for long-form web fiction, covering emotional stakes, tension rhythm, climax layering, foreshadowing payoff pacing, value shifts and event architecture, multi-thread weaving, arc design, and chapter ending hooks. Use when planning outlines.

name: novel-structure-extractor
description: Extract outlines, chapter summaries, character profiles, growth arcs, scenes, systems, and evidence-backed structure from indexed novels.

name: novel-studio
description: 通用小说写作工作室。支持管理多部不同类型（现代/古代/言情/武侠/科幻）的小说项目，每部小说独立管理大纲、时间线与人物。写章节时必须执行强制六步流程（读取设定→风格进化→反馈规避→要点提取→写作→覆盖检查），不可跳过。当用户提及「写小说」「续写」「新建小说项目」「更新大纲」「同步设定」等，应优先考虑使用本 Skill。触发句式：「创建新小说...」「写 XXX 的第 X 章」「续写 XXX」「更新 XXX 的设定」等。

name: novel-studio
description: Plan, draft, continue, revise, review, migrate, package, and create covers for short-, medium-, or long-form Chinese fiction. Use when Codex needs to start or maintain a novel project, design characters or worldbuilding, create full/volume/chapter outlines, write or repair chapters, run automated publication-readiness pilots and blind full-text reviews, reduce formulaic or AI-like prose through evidence-based authenticity revision, migrate a novel-planner project, prepare platform-facing synopsis copy, or produce a cover through $codex-gpt-image without any pen name or author attribution.

name: novel-studio
description: 小说工作台使用指南——浏览器端「小说」视图/HUD 的交互约定：实时渲染、章节编辑保存、请求队列、数据与发布面板的读写边界

name: novel-studio
description: The playbook for running a whole novel project inside OpenTales — from a brainstorm or idea to a planned, drafted, revised manuscript — and for resuming one midway. Load this whenever the author asks to plan the story, start the novel, turn notes/a brainstorm into a book, build the story bible, set up characters and world, outline or write chapters in sequence, 'keep going', 'continue', 'pick up where we left off', or anything that spans more than one document or chapter. Also load it at the start of any new session on a project that already has a Ledger. It tells you how to organize folders…

name: novel-studio
description: End-to-end Chinese web novel production workflow for turning a novel idea into a structured deliverable project. Covers hot-search and trend scan, discovery discussion, requirement intake, market/topic analysis, title confirmation, story planning, outline design, character bible creation, chapter drafting, polishing, proofreading, final review, and optional Feishu Wiki sync. Use when the user wants to create, develop, optimize, or deliver a serialized novel, web fiction project, long-form Chinese fiction pipeline, or a full novel production workflow from concept to manuscript.

name: novel-studio
description: 以真实子 agent 协作创作、续写、审稿和修订长篇小说，用普通文件维护作品记忆，支持跨会话、跨工具接续。

name: novel-studio
description: 规划、创作、续写、审核、修订并导出有长期记忆和连续性门禁的中文长篇小说或完整短故事。用户要互动确定框架、根据近期公开数据选题、跨上下文续写、做周期或完稿审核、生成番茄交付物或受控修订线上副本时使用；长篇每章和短故事全文都必须实际调用 humanizer-zh，纯非虚构写作不使用。

name: novel-style
description: 文风原型与风格指纹。按项目风格档加载对应原型参考，把"像谁"落成可测参数（句长/修辞/心理距离/留白），并管理对通用文风规则的合法偏离。当用户说"文风"、"风格太普通"、"想要某作家的味道"、"句子节奏不对"时使用。

name: novel-style-audit
description: Audit novel expression repetition using read-only statistics and contextual judgment. Use when checking repeated phrases, sentence patterns, openings, punctuation, actions or motifs; distinguish useful recurrence from ineffective repetition before proposing changes, without claiming AI-text detection.

name: novel-style-engine
description: 写法引擎 —— 从用户投喂的样本中抽取文风特征，编译成可注入 prompt 的写作约束。整合 AI-NWA 写法引擎 6 层结构 + 3 强度档 + 5 任务模板。当用户说"学这个文风"、"提取写法"、"投喂样本"、"我想要 XX 风格"、"看这个的味道"、"反 AI 化"、"编译写法" 等时触发。是本套件相对其他 AI 写作工具的核心差异化模块。

name: novel-style-extract
description: 从参考作品中提取风格指纹。 触发条件: "提取风格"、"分析文风"、"style extract"、"提取XX的风格"

name: novel-style-fingerprint
description: 小说文风指纹提取。用于从参考文本中提炼可复用的叙事视角、句式节奏、对话比例、描写方式、情绪表达、禁用模式和风格规则，适合 reference-style-chunk、reference-style-analysis、style-fingerprint-extract 任务。

name: novel-style-learn
description: Use when studying reference novels to extract transferable fiction techniques such as pacing, hook design, dialogue pressure, and scene transitions without cloning an author voice.

name: novel-style-learner
description: 参考书风格学习技能。触发关键词：学习风格、分析参考书、提取风格、风格学习。当用户说这些词时自动触发。功能：分析参考小说的语言风格、叙事节奏、人物塑造、冲突设计，提取可复用的写作模式，生成风格指南。

name: novel-style-learning
description: 网文风格学习——学习网文与传统文学的区别，掌握网文特有的写作风格和读者预期管理

name: novel-style-pov-system-designer
description: Use when HLD artifact 09 must design style, POV, narrative distance, communication rules, image system, and prohibited expressions.

name: novel-style-reference
description: A real-novel writing style reference library backed by the novel_query_style_reference MCP tool. Returns annotated extracts from published Chinese novels indexed by technique × emotion. Use the MCP tool to fetch human-written examples that break AI templated expression patterns during chapter writing or review.

name: novel-style-reference
description: 小说叙事风格库。写小说时引用某部作品的叙事风格（如「引用《伊豆的舞女》的叙事风格」「按 XXX 的风格写」）则加载对应风格文档作为写作参考；用户提供某部小说原文并请求学习时，分析并总结为以作品名命名的风格文档存入 styles/，供后续引用。

name: novel-style-revise
description: Apply approved novel expression alternatives within a bounded revision scope, preserving original prose history, meaning, voice and protected motifs. Use when revising repetitive or homogenized prose after an audit, then reverse-review changes and submit any actual state differences for confirmation.

name: novel-style-variations
description: 文体模写世界選手権V9王者が、ひとつの物語素材を、司馬遼太郎風・向田邦子風・角野栄子風・三島由紀夫風・芥川龍之介風・直木三十五風・ボルヘス風・村松友視風・宮本常一風など、選んだ作家の数だけ並行して書き分ける。番号で選ぶ短い対話で、素材と出力場所を決めればあとはおまかせ。

name: novel-subject-designer
description: 将小说意图卡转化为经作者确认或明确授权的主体定义，锁定核心选择载体、行动目标与代价、关键关系、对抗与世界压力。用于已有意图卡、但尚未明确谁推动故事及其选择为何有代价时；不用于人物小传、完整情节、场景或小说正文。

name: novel-subtopic-explorer
description: Identifies, verifies, and explores previously undiscussed subtopics within a broader subject area when the user requests something new or unexamined. Enforces a multi-stage negative filtering protocol using MemoryPlugin and past chat history tools (recall_chat_history, search_memories) to guarantee topics have not been substantively explored in previous conversations.

name: novel-summarizer
description: This page used to hold an archived copy of this skill. The archive now lives in the registry's data repository.

name: novel-summarizer
description: Read and comprehend novel text, summarize into fluent story outline. Suitable for novel initial screening, generating 500-800 word story outlines

name: novel-summarizer
description: 阅读理解小说文本，总结成流畅的故事大纲。适用于小说初筛选、生成500-800字故事大纲

name: novel-supporting-cast-analysis
description: Use when the user wants to identify the ten most important supporting characters from AI-generated character cards, rerank them with an AI judgment pass, and expand each chosen supporting character into a protagonist-style durable card package.

name: novel-sync
description: 章节完成后回写知识图谱、剧情摘要、伏笔状态到项目记忆。触发词："同步""sync""更新状态""更新知识图谱""更新past"。

name: novel-sync
description: 章节写完后的资料同步流程。把新写章节里的事件/关系变化/伏笔/金句同步到前情梳理、人物档案、伏笔清单、经典语录。触发词：同步前情、同步伏笔、同步人物档案、章节同步、写后同步、novel-sync。
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep, AskUserQuestion

name: novel-sync
description: 接纳用户对 chapters/final 的手动修改：检测被改动的章节，重新抽取事实并重建账本与索引。

name: novel-tactical-payoff
description: 设计和审查小说的智谋较量、以弱胜强、群像协作与具体胜负。适用于计策不可信、对手降智、主角靠嘴赢、能力临时扩张或胜果落空；涵盖斗法、谈判和竞争。

name: novel-tag-character-consistency
description: tag/<romaji>.md の Danbooru 行を、character.md の固定外見（目・髪・肌・種族など）と 照合し、状況ブロック間の抜け・ブレ・誤混入がないか確認する。Tag Mode 完了後または改稿時に使う。

name: novel-tag-md-format
description: tag/characters/<character_id>.yaml（YAML IR）からエクスポートされた novels/<作品>/tag/<romaji>.md の見出し・Danbooru Tags 行・インデントを tools/image_provider_novel_tag_batch.py と整合させる互換Markdown層維持スキル。 キャラクタータグの構造正本は manga-prompt-ir の YAML IR であり、このスキルは 人間向けの可読副本かつ既存バッチ向けの Markdown フォーマットを保つために使う。

name: novel-taste
description: 通过对比样例测评，挖掘用户真实的正文风格偏好。当用户想确认/调整文风、不确定自己喜欢什么风格、或想建立创作基线时加载。

name: novel-technique-character-card-workshop
description: 重量级角色写卡、人物塑造、人设整理与角色理解流程。用于用户要从模糊角色印象、萌点、标签、OC、人设草稿或角色卡想法整理成可写角色，进行 20/24/80/200 问循环问答，设计或校验基础信息、调色盘、三面性、混色、核心人格层、二次解释、意象，或防止 AI 把角色写成标签化人设；适合作为 novel-setup 角色设计阶段的深挖前置或参考技法。用户明确要求批量出候选答案再逐题挑选时，可走可选的批量候选模式。

name: novel-text-file-output
description: 小説本文を会話にだけ書かず、novels/.../_novel_text/novel_text*.md へ必ず保存する。 「執筆完了」の定義（ファイル更新＋確認）は本スキルで固定する。 追記・シーン追加も新規執筆と同一の完了条件とする。 執筆直後にファイル更新を Read または novel_char_count.py で確認する。 「これからツールで退避／加筆／確認します」と述べたら宣言のみで終えず実行まで進める（実行継続）。

name: novel-text-rewrite-lint
description: _novel_text/*.md の体裁規則（章番号・三点リーダー・セリフ句点・段落インデントなど）を tools/novel_text_rewrite_lint.py で機械チェックし、清書完了の判定を補助する。 執筆直後は --profile grammar --fix で誤打の第一校正（rewrite の代わりにはしない）。

name: novel-thread-designer
description: 设计小说的故事线（Thread）体系——在 PRD 定义了"讲什么故事"之后，本技能设计故事的"线结构"：定义主线、展开线、隐藏线及其核心节点序列，为 HLD 的讲述线设计提供原料。输出的线设计结果可直接被 HLD writer 调用。

name: novel-thread-system-designer
description: Use when HLD artifact 08 must design main, hidden, emotional, thematic, and support threads with distribution, crossover, and closure.

name: novel-time-information-system-designer
description: Use when HLD artifact 07 must design story time, narrative time, information objects, knowledge distribution, concealment, and reveal conditions.

name: novel-timeline
description: Maintain a novel timeline and test time, travel and concurrent actions. Use when sequencing events, checking ages, elapsed time, injuries or alibis, comparing simultaneous scenes, or repairing chronology without inventing dates or travel capabilities.

name: novel-to-ai-drama-episodes
description: Turn a Novel into Character-Consistent AI Drama Episodes: ArcReel: novels or screenplays become character, scene and prop assets, storyboards, video shots and finished episodes; agent skill plus remote MCP. git clone https://github.com/ArcReel/ArcReel.git

name: novel-to-ai-short-drama
description: 将小说、网文或故事片段改编为可直接服务 AI 短剧生产的分集导演台本与逐镜头方案，包含时长规划、画面化改写、表演调度、景别、机位、运镜、声音、连续性与生成备注。适用于小说剧本化、短剧化、分镜化、导演化、AI 视频脚本和拍摄台本；不用于只做文学润色或续写小说。

name: novel-to-anime-drama
description: 小说转AI动漫短剧工业化流水线。输入完整小说文本，输出可用于AI动漫短剧制作的全套资产：分集剧本、角色设定、分镜脚本、AI生图prompt、配音文本、配乐指导。适用于使用liblib/seedance2.0等AI工具进行动漫短剧制作的场景。

name: novel-to-comic
description: 将小说忠实改编为完整漫画：按原文章节逐章完成细节清单、详细剧本和逐格分镜，禁止过度概括、漏关键剧情或虚构；本卷汇总审查锁定后再制作，整页一次生成，手机单页1080×2400、单页限定3–4格纵排（常规3格、信息简单可4格）且字高可读，维护人物一致性、整页验收并导出。用于小说转漫画、续做和定向返修。

name: novel-to-comic
description: Convert long-form fiction from TXT or EPUB into a recoverable comic production project. Use when the user wants to adapt a novel into manga/comic pages, create story bibles, visual bibles, storyboard JSON, image-generation task sheets, PDF/CBZ outputs, or continue an existing novel-to-comic project from filesystem state.

name: novel-to-comic
description: Use when converting Chinese fiction chapters into manga/manhua adaptation layers, storyboards, image-generation panels, visual audits, lettering/layout configs, or debugging quality problems in the novel-to-comic pipeline.

name: novel-to-drama
description: 将小说片段、章节或梗概改成可排练的中文短剧剧本，同时输出 Markdown 与 JSON，包含场次、人物动作、对白、冲突升级和结尾钩子。适用于短剧策划、试写和分集拆解；保留原作事实，不承诺爆款、过审或收益。

name: novel-to-drama
description: 小说/网文改编漫剧分集剧本的编剧 skill——从番茄小说等链接抽正文（字体反爬走本地渲染 + macOS Vision OCR），逐卷拆解人物/伏笔/名场面，按故事单元分集（正片≥60 由节拍成型、不锁上限、禁一章一集），逐集产出剧本条目与视觉化标注，交付可直进分镜的分集剧本。

name: novel-to-game
description: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on web, desktop, mobile, WeChat/Douyin mini-games, or TapTap Maker. Orchestrates requirements intake, novel analysis, concept/world/visual design, environment-aware build, and blind-playtest QA in any language. Use for novel to game, story to game, book to game, WeChat mini-game, Douyin mini-game, TapTap Maker, interactive story, text adventure, or interactive film. NovelToGame 总入口。把任意语言的小说、拆文库或写作工程转成忠于原著、可在网页、桌面/移动端、微信/抖音小游戏或 TapTap 制造完整游玩的游戏，编排拆书、策划美术、环境适配构建与新玩家盲玩验收。

name: novel-to-game
